name: Regional demand forecast

algorithm.normalization: One maximum across seven forecast days for each source area
algorithm.confidence: HIGH after 6 matching complete days and 100 orders; otherwise MODERATE if thresholds met

geography.serverScope: active searching current_work_region_id; otherwise profile work_region_id/home_region_id
geography.capture: Pinned pickup region, falling back to branch region at first ingestion
geography.fallback: Parent district only, explicitly labeled, only when local data insufficient

capture.source: DynamoDB stream on dispatch METADATA plus hourly reconciliation
capture.deduplication: Conditional permanent dataset-scoped SHA256 order key, retained120 days; capture lookback60 days

datasets.TEST: Captured staging activity from deployment coverageStart onward
datasets.SIMULATION: Synthetic history passed through same forecast function; separate snapshot keys and health; staging trialdriver allowlist only
datasets.LIVE: Separate keys and production collector configuration required at launch; all staging records excluded

reliability.boundedScans: 2000 pages /250000 rows /180s per source scan; failure keeps old health, stale forecasts hidden

deviceInstall: Native profile254 installed successfully on existing test iPhone
launchRequirements: Deploy equivalent isolated infrastructure in production with LIVE dataset and no simulation allowlist or region
Set coverageStart to real collection start; never import staging or simulation events
Expect insufficient-data state until thresholds met; synthetic tests establish implementation correctness, not real forecast accuracy
Configure operations alarm notification destination and monitor stream lag/failures
Review scan/index capacity before high traffic; bounded reconciler intentionally refuses partial totals
Track outages of upstream order placement separately if future operational incidents must be excluded beyond collector gaps
Evaluate accuracy against real demand before lowering confidence thresholds
